text:
Mira: Quick idea for the plans page before next week's webinar — try an inline quick-quote + micro-FAQ and route quote submits to sales.
Evan: Nice. short hypothesis?
Mira: fewer clicks + visible ballpark = more demo requests and higher-quality leads.
Kai: agree. propose two variants: InlineQuickQuote (tokens input + concurrency dropdown) vs EmailQuote (asks email & company size, sends estimate). both client-side.
Priya: tracking: add hidden field `experiment=quickquote_may26` and `utm_experiment=quickquote_may26`. events: `quote_open`, `quote_run`, `quote_submit`, `plan_cta_click`.
Sam (sales-bot): FYI I can create HS task when `lead_score>=60` and `experiment` tag present. confirm threshold = 60?
Lina: 60 works. sales wants notification format: `experiment=quickquote_may26 notify=sales-eng@redwood.com` in payload.
Evan: micro-FAQ (collapsed): Qs: "How are tokens billed?", "Can I reserve capacity?", "Is data private?" answers one-line + 'learn more'.
Kai: accessibility: inline inputs need labels, sliders keyboard-nav, ARIA live for estimate changes.
Mira: rollout plan: copy freeze today 6pm, dev Wed, QA Thu, soft launch Fri 10% traffic, monitor through weekend, webinar Mon.
Priya: metrics: primary = demo-request rate per 1k visitors; secondary = MQL rate and revenue-weighted leads. split by US / EU.
Sam (sales-bot): I'll smoke-test: when form contains `experiment=quickquote_may26` create hs_task and post to #sales-inbound. will report results.
Mira: ACTIONS: Mira finalize copy today, Kai build inline & modal, Priya wire analytics and HubSpot mapping, Sam confirm HS automation, Lina draft sales micro-brief.
Mira: unless objections i'll push copy to staging tonight. :rocket:
